name: designcanvas
description: Local-first AI design workspace with an infinite canvas
author: DesignCanvas Contributors

scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm desktop:renderer:dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron desktop/main.cjs"
scripts.desktop:preview: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n next,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm desktop:renderer:preview" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron desktop/main.cjs"
scripts.desktop:dist: pnpm build && pnpm desktop:prepare-renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.desktop:dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm desktop:prepare-renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --x64
